related.title: 張量運算加速器
related.why: 矩陣分塊與頻寬分析相通
related.whyEn: Matrix tiling and bandwidth analysis transfer
related.transfer: 矩陣分塊與頻寬分析相通
related.transferEn: Matrix tiling and bandwidth analysis transfer
related.difference: SIMT 核心較通用，專用陣列受形狀與資料型別限制
related.differenceEn: SIMT is general; dedicated arrays constrain shapes and types
practice: 由「執行階層」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「SIMT 核心較通用，專用陣列受形狀與資料型別限制」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From execution hierarchy, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "SIMT is general; dedicated arrays constrain shapes and types", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

courses.summaryEn: The course connects public principles and large-system handoffs through simt execution, reuse and resource occupancy. Maps identify representative vendors, standards institutions or research/open-technology references; no institutional teaching or universal implementation-site claim is made.
courses.connection: 從「執行階層」到「CPU 對照」逐項檢查架構、介面與證據。
courses.connectionEn: Connect execution hierarchy to cpu reference and audit architecture, interfaces and evidence.

history.year: 公開技術脈絡 / Public technical context
history.title: 執行與索引
history.text: 官方公開資料「CUDA 程式設計模型」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「執行階層」及「索引覆蓋」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference CUDA programming model supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with execution hierarchy and index coverage before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
